newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 60,000 t corn, 60,000 t soybean-trader.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 60,000 t corn, 60,000 t soybean-trader.

text.p: Egypt bought on Wednesday two 30,000 tonne shipments of yellow corn from Lorico and two 30,000 tonne shipments of soybean from Finagrain, one trader said.
The trader gave details of the purchases as follows:
- 30,000 tonnes of yellow corn for $134.95 per tonne C and F for delivery in the second half of April.
- 30,000 tonnes of yellow corn for $136 per tonne C and F for delivery in the second half of March.
- 30,000 tonnes of soybean for $293.77 per tonne C and F for delivery in the second half of May.
- 30,000 tonnes of soybean for $295 per tonne C and F for delivery in the second half of April.
The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Food Industries had said last month that it wanted to buy 30,000 tonnes of U.S. or Argentine yellow corn and 30,000 tonnes of grade 2 soybean of any origin.
The trader said it was likely that the company found the price was right and bought more. -- Cairo newsroom +20 2 578 3290/1
